Dishonored 2 is a whale of a good time!  It is a sequel that takes place 10ish years later,  Emily Kaldwin gets taken off the throne by a relative and tries to find her way to reclaim it.  You can play as Emily or your old man Corvo, both with a unique set of powers. 

Overall I recommend it!  There are many appearances of characters from the first game, but also many new ones as well! The same can be said about the powers and enemies.  To me Dishonored 2 is like  Avatar 2, it's probably the objectively better in the series, but the first one immersed you with its newness and setting!  I think Dishonored 2's greatest strength is its creativity in its level design and new mechanics, but it never quite reached the cleverness in its storytelling that the first game did.

Possitive aspects:
- A soundtrack that fits almost perfectly in every level
- Captivating and Gory Artwork
- Pretty nice story with mutliple endings (kind off)

Neutral aspects:
- It is pretty punishing and if you are not willing to try enough you might just give up on it
- If you're playing with a keyboard you might find the controls a little wacky
- The backtracking might seem boring to some

Negative aspects:
- The game doesn't give you a proper sense of direction and where to go next and you will end up not knowing what to do, if you're new to it
- Combat is a little too slow and robotic and at some point depends mostly on memorization rather than skill, which isn't really that bad but kinda bothers me

Overall the game's pretty good and while it has some notable drawbacks I cannot help but recommend it

The Good
- Good graphics, runs well
- Combat is fun (abilities and guns are cool)
- The twins

The Bad
- Story is a mess 
- Missions are extremely lateral 
(kill some mobs then go somewhere, deliver something kill mobs then go somewhere)
- Character is unlikable
- Impossible to explore other locations in map, due to enemies infinitely re spawning

6/10 overall
